title: Fixed Double Open End Cap and Spine Sampling Cylinder
description: One wholly newly authored complete empty water-sampling-cylinder-inspired static exterior. A single thick long tube has genuine top and bottom open ports. Each end has a complete separate solid cap fixed vertically out beside the port on a full side pivot, with its own continuous curved retaining cord attached to a full external longitudinal spine. Two entire outer clamp bands and short rear bridges attach tube to spine, with a true open rear handgrip and a small integrated display foot. Unlike the old closed paired diving cylinders there are no domed bottle bottoms, paired tanks or top valves; unlike the footed laboratory cylinder there is no inner floor, pour lip or scale. Every visible part newly authored. One model zero scenes. Static illustrative empty exhibit only, not a usable Niskin bottle or working hinge/closure: no water collection, depth, pressure, sealing, fluid volume, deployment, scientific accuracy, manufacture, handling or safety claim. Rig animation interaction not made.
